title: Fellow MallWorld-dweller Introduction
content: Hi everyone. I'm a Mallworld enthusiast, new to Reddit. Starting a project for 2026 that maps Mallworld using text and image, each month revealing a new area and aesthetic. I've lived in Mallworld almost every night since I was a child (as many here have) and consider it to be a gateway to the afterlife. An aspect of the Bardo. Anyhow, very happy to be here and I hope the admins will be okay with my sharing my daily creations.
